Use the original tool names and arguments. The first generate_assets call uses
the existing local HSSD catalog through a deterministic metadata retrieval adapter;

actual dimensions and metadata provenance are returned; no silent rescaling.
Missing categories or unsupported operations return explicit tool failures.

## Task
